Recipes PBS with cations, pH 7.2-7.4 137.93 mM sodium chloride 8.05 mM sodium phosphate dibasic 1.47 mM potassium phosphate monobasic 2.67 mM potassium chloride 0.49 mM magnesium chloride (hexahydrate) 0.90 mM calcium chloride (anhydride) Ligand binding buffer (LBB), pH 7.2-7.4 HBSS 1% BSA 1 mM CaCl 2 0.05% sodium azide 4% PFA in PBS Dilute 16% PFA (1 in 4 with PBS containing cations) Soluble Notch ECD ligand with Fc tag Briefly, HEK 293T cells stably expressing a construct for Notch ligand with Fc tag ( Yang et al. , 2005 ) were grown to 90% confluence before the medium was changed to serum-free Pro293a medium with glutamine After 72 h, conditioned medium containing secreted Fc-tagged ligand is carefully collected trying not to disturb the cell monolayer. The medium is filtered through a 0.22 µm syringe filter and the filtrate is concentrated using an Amicon Ultra 15 centrifugal unit with 30 Kd molecular weight cutoff The concentration of the Fc-tagged ligand is determined using Western blot analysis of titrated Notch ligand compared with known amounts of IgG as described ( Stahl et al. , 2008 ; Hou et al. , 2012 )

steps.title: Wash adherent cells
steps.instruction: Remove culture medium and wash the cell layer once with 5 ml cold PBS (with cations) at room temperature.

steps.title: Dissociate cells with enzyme‑free reagent
steps.instruction: Remove PBS, add 1 ml enzyme‑free dissociation reagent per T75 flask or 10 cm dish, keep at room temperature, transfer flask/dish to 37 °C, after 1 min check detachment; if incomplete, continue at 37 °C until cells detach, then vigorously tap sides to aid detachment, and resuspend cells in 9 ml medium containing 10 % FBS to obtain a single‑cell suspension. For cells that resist dissociation, scrape them off and resuspend in medium with 10 % FBS; allow clumped cells to settle.

steps.title: Count and pellet cells
steps.instruction: Count cells; ensure at least 2 × 10⁶ cells per ligand per replicate (using 0.5 × 10⁶ cells for unstained, 0.5 × 10⁶ for negative control, and 1 × 10⁶ for each test sample). Transfer the required volume to a 15 ml Falcon tube and centrifuge at 115 × g (1,000 rpm) for 10 min at room temperature. Aspirate supernatant carefully and wash the pellet with 10 ml ligand binding buffer (LBB).

steps.title: Fix cells with 4 % PFA
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml 4 % PFA per 10⁷ cells, vortex briefly to resuspend, incubate 10 min at room temperature, centrifuge again at 115 × g (1,000 rpm) for 10 min, discard supernatant, wash twice with 10 ml LBB, then resuspend cells to 10⁶ cells / ml in LBB. Fixed cells may be stored at 4 °C for ≥ 1 month.

steps.title: Aliquot cells for assay
steps.instruction: Label 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes and aliquot 0.5–1.0 × 10⁶ cells in LBB for each condition: (a) unstained control, (b) negative control (Fc tag alone or secondary antibody alone), and (c) each Notch‑ligand‑Fc test sample.

steps.title: Wash and block Fc receptors
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the aliquoted tubes at 420 × g (2,000 rpm) for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, wash cells with 1 ml ice‑cold LBB, repeat wash once, discard supernatant. Add 50 µl FcR block diluted 1:50 in LBB to all tubes except the unstained control (which receives 50 µl LBB), vortex gently, and incubate 15 min on ice. Do not wash thereafter.

steps.title: Add ligand or control protein
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl Notch‑ligand‑Fc or Fc‑tag alone (containing 100–1,000 ng in 100 µl LBB) to the appropriate tubes; to unstained or secondary‑only tubes add 100 µl LBB. Vortex gently and incubate 1 h on ice with mixing every 15 min, or at 4 °C with rotation.

steps.title: Wash post‑ligand incubation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 420 × g (2,000 rpm) for 5 min at room temperature, discard supernatant, wash cells with 1 ml ice‑cold LBB, repeat wash once, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Add secondary anti‑Fc antibody
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl secondary anti‑Fc antibody diluted 1:100 in LBB to all tubes except the unstained control, vortex to resuspend, incubate 30 min on ice or at 4 °C with rotation, and keep tubes wrapped in aluminum foil to protect from light.

steps.title: Final washes and filter cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 420 × g (2,000 rpm) for 5 min at room temperature, discard supernatant, wash twice with 1 ml ice‑cold LBB, discard supernatant each time, then add 250–500 µl ice‑cold LBB, mix, and pass the suspension through the strainer cap of a 5 ml polystyrene round‑bottom tube to remove clumps. Keep samples protected from light and proceed to flow cytometry.
